author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: Deterministic expander walks and polynomial-evaluation small-bias coefficients give q d^(P-1) h^2 candidate rows per round, q < 2m, d=O(log(m+2)), h < 4P; each support of size at least m/P is rejected with probability at least 1/40, enabling 28n greedy rounds under the source counting oracle. This compresses preprocessing but does not improve the selected SAT bound.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size construction, coefficient family and oracle cost composition
Find a changed contraction or preprocessing contract where candidate compression affects a dominant term
No improved alpha or full new SAT algorithm is claimed
